hero.eyebrow: Market intelligence for professional NQ desks
hero.title: NQ target intelligence your desk can evaluate over time.
hero.description: Harper Vance publishes qualifying intraday NQ targets, then delivers a complete daily email record and weekly validation report—so trading, research, and oversight can judge the intelligence from retained evidence.

included.title: One subscription. A complete record from target to review.
included.description: Harper Vance delivers the same core intelligence across every license. Access, delivery methods, history, and internal usage rights scale with your firm.
included.qualification: Targets are published only when predefined conditions qualify. A session may produce no targets.

artifacts.title: During the session
artifacts.description: Qualifying NQ targets are published with direction, timestamp, and session context through approved delivery channels.

artifacts.title: After the session
artifacts.description: A complete daily email report records every target generated, plus reached and unreached outcomes.

artifacts.title: At the end of the week
artifacts.description: A validation report groups the week day by day so your team can review consistency and model behavior.

problem.title: If the original call cannot be reviewed, it cannot be evaluated.
problem.description: Targets scattered across messages and after-the-fact recaps leave a desk guessing. Harper Vance keeps the issued target, its context, and its outcome together.
problem.belief: Your team sees what was generated—not a rewritten version of the session.
items: Reached and unreached outcomes stay visible

operations.title: Use it as another input—not another execution system.
operations.description: Harper Vance adds an independent, reviewable source of NQ context to the process your desk already controls.
operations.delivery: Secure dashboard, email, Slack or Teams, with API and webhooks on eligible licenses.
items: No trade recommendations or execution instructions
